purpose: Stage-1 inventory for rebuilding v30's predictions on a new movement file (insurance against a separate final test file). Read-only; companion of inventory.md.

target.recipe: non-LIRF: max(0.3*(v9+residual) + 0.7*((1-0.75)*committee + 0.75*(0.25 ens_ctx_e24 + 0.25 ens_ctx_e24b + 0.5 ens_ctx_e32)), -12); LIRF non-population: round-B blends of v9, ens_v22_lirf_q, ens_ctx_lirf (lctx_b100_up); LIRF fill population: v9

v9.first_producer: tools/export_adsb_v25.py (v23 export; carried unchanged into v24-v30 details)
v9.refit_needed: LIRF mixture classifier refit from Jan-Nov 2025 labels (seconds, byte-identical)

residual.first_producer: tools/export_adsb_v25.py (adj2, cat) + tools/refit_adsb_rnn.py (rnet) combined by tools/export_adsb_rnn.py
residual.refit_needed: adj2 for any target month other than 2026-01/2026-07 (321.8 s on 16 threads)

committee.first_producer: tools/run_adsb_learner_dec.py per leaf (Azure arcw0-7, 19 Sep) -> tools/export_december_refit.py means

ens_ctx_e32.cpu_reload: within 0.087 s RMS / 0.34 s p99 per seed (verification_v30)

scope.producer: tools/export_adsb_v11.py::ranking_table + run_adsb_v11.SCOPES (+ lirf_nonpop_unmatched registered in run_adsb_v24)

stages.name: Phase-1 row features + movement context
guards: validate_inputs: raw file hashes vs download receipts

stages.name: phase3/phase4/phase5R/weather/nmclock/timeline layers (335 columns, 276 predictors)
stages.first_tool: each frozen bundle.py prepare (timeline 108.66 s, 6.87 GiB, arcw0)
guards: one reserved-period raise in each of five features.py
stages.context: frozen ranking rows used Jan-Nov 2025 + ranking 2026-01/07 movements; headway features need full history
stages.labels: read only to save them (make optional)

stages.name: weather + runways
stages.external_download: IEM ASOS for 10 stations over the new period, one request at a time

stages.name: adsb.lol surface extraction
stages.ran_on: Azure workers (~33 s/day, 14 processes; streams 2-4 GB/day of GitHub release tar parts, globe_history_2026 for 2026)

stages.name: v7 frozen, v9_frozen, v7 twelve-month, v9
guards: export_adsb_v25: predicted_ids_sha256, uploaded-v9 reproduction, v22 recorded v9

stages.name: committee + LIRF tree tables (29 leaves)
stages.frame: timeline features + learner ADS-B table + v19 extras

stages.name: residual stage
stages.caveat: neighbour columns not bit-reproducible across rebuilds (unstable sort moves a few dozen nb_runway_prev/next values)
guards: rnn_ranking_table: scope equals v25's recorded scope

stages.name: recipe, export, verify, audit
tools: tools/export_adsb_ctx4.py (rebuilds v29 from recorded detail; refuses unless integers equal uploaded v29)
stages.new_file: compute every component; skip reproduction guards; template path as argument

blockers: B1 new file format unknown (arrivals and in-block times are required by v9 turnarounds, arrival tokens, timeline surface context)
B2 new dates need adsb.lol extraction, IEM pull, v19 features and a token split
B3 adj2 boosters exist only for target months 2026-01 and 2026-07

B4 hard-coded ranking plumbing: RANKING_MONTHS in ~20 tools, 'ranking.parquet' keys, build_ctx_tokens.SOURCES, build_adsb_features.raw_path, bundle validate_config, Phase-1 raw-hash validation, uploaded-vN reproduction guards
B5 neighbour features not bit-reproducible -> tolerance in the dry run
B6 declared context set for timeline/traffic features
B7 workstation memory 15.7 GB (v7 twelve-month prediction, full token build) -> Azure VM may be needed
code_changes: src/prc2026_final/features.py: generalised December builder (raw path, months, context sources; labels optional; --verify against frozen features/ranking.parquet)
src/prc2026_final/adsb.py: frozen-stands matching for any days/raw file (both match dirs), v19 features, learner ADS-B table, residual nb table
token split for a named source (build_ctx_tokens imported, not edited)
tools/final_predict.py --raw F --template T --root OUT: v7, v9, 29 leaves, 144 nets, residual, recipe arithmetic imported from frozen modules, export_submission with the given template

runbook_hours.total_estimate: 5-7 h after the file appears (about 2 h less if the months are Jan/Jul 2026)

dry_run.input: copy of data/raw/ranking.parquet as runs/final_dryrun/input/final.parquet, template data/raw/submitting.parquet, fresh output root

acceptance.features: equal to frozen timeline features/ranking.parquet (4 cyclic NM-clock columns <= 2e-16)
acceptance.matches_caches_tokens: recorded content hashes or row-level equality
acceptance.e32_nets: <= 0.5 s RMS and 2 s p99 per seed
acceptance.residual: declared tolerance (e.g. 99.9% of rows within 1e-6 s) because of nb instability
acceptance.final: report differing integer rows and max |d| vs uploaded v30; never overwrite or re-upload v30
